question: Raja Parba, also known as Mithuna Sankranti, is a ______ -day-long festival of womanhood celebrated in Odisha, India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Parba (Mithuna Sankranti)-**

 
 
• **Raja Parba**, also known as **Mithuna Sankranti**, is a cultural festival celebrated in the Indian state of **Odisha**.
 
• It marks the onset of the agricultural season and is observed during the **mid-June period**, coinciding with the **solar transition of the zodiac sign Gemini (Mithuna).**
 
• It is a **three-day-long festival celebrating womanhood.**
 
• **2ⁿd day **of the festival marks the **beginning of the solar month of Mithuna,** on which the season of rains starts.
 
• It is believed that **Mother Goddess Earth undergoes menstruation during the first three days.**
 
• 4th day is called **Vasumati Snana.**
 
• Folk songs and dance performances, especially the **"Dalkhai" **dance, are an integral part of the Raja Parba celebrations.
 
• 
 
The festival signifies the importance of nature, agriculture, and the vitality of women in Odisha's culture and tradition
